description: Get the full measured profile of one MCP server: description, measured tool list with parameters, liveness and deep-test outcomes, key status, endpoint and region. Call after find_mcp, with the name or slug from a find_mcp result, to inspect a candidate before connecting. The profile also carries profile_url (the public evidence page). MCPYP never proxies calls — use get_config to connect to the server yourself.

name.description: Server name or slug from find_mcp results
